scores.tell: Fabric seat is smooth with only faint stitching; metal tubes slightly plastic-glossy, but the matte/shiny mix is close to real.
Slide and pool tiles are uniformly lacquered plastic. Water ripples are sharp, and the whole card has little matte contrast.
Sand is smooth and matte. The red metal body and white dish carry soft gloss, and the rivets are small. The dish is slightly chalky.
Wood grain is large and decorative, with swirly marks on the arrows. The surfaces are evenly glossy and look like carved toy wood.
The glass has convincing highlights and the liquid has small bubbles. The paper umbrella is a bit plasticky, but the gloss range is good.
Smooth metal and glass dome with a good gloss mix. The orange lights are glossy beads. The gloss is slightly uniform.
Stone table and stools are fairly flat matte with faint crack marks, so they look more painted than modeled. The grass is stylized and flat, with little fine texture.
Wood hull, sail cloth and water foam all read as separate materials. The planks have fine grain. The sails are a little smooth.
The door and leaves have a good soft sheen, and the bricks are lightly textured. The wreath flowers are slightly waxy and the leaves are a little repetitive.
The tombstone is a uniform soft-plastic or clay gloss. It has no stone grain or chips, and the bite edge is smooth rubber.
